name: A Very Scandalous Proposal
source:
You set out for England determined to uncover one of the aristocracies' oldest families secrets. What will you turn up?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/A_Very_Scandalous_Proposal]Choices Wikia[/url]]
